bentham.definition: n. English philosopher and jurist; founder of utilitarianism (1748-1831)

benthamic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to Bentham or Benthamism.
benthamic.translation: a. 边沁（英国伦理学家, 法学家, 资产阶级功利主义的主要成员）学说的, 功利主义的

benthamism.definition:
n. That phase of the doctrine of utilitarianism taught by
   Jeremy Bentham; the doctrine that the morality of actions is estimated
   and determined by their utility; also, the theory that the sensibility
   to pleasure and the recoil from pain are the only motives which
   influence human desires and actions, and that these are the sufficient
   explanation of ethical and jural conceptions.
benthamism.translation: n. 功利主义, 边沁学说

benthamite.definition: n. One who believes in Benthamism.
benthamite.translation: n. 功利主义者, 边沁学说者

benthamites.definition:
plural of benthamite
n. One who believes in Benthamism.
benthamites.translation: (benthamite 的复数) n.功利主义者, 边沁学说者
